analysis.reason: No tests returned meaningful real data through the 'out' port.
analysis.description: Analyzing all 6 tests: Test 1 outputs to 'out' but the data contains only undefined values ({ 'Segment ID': undefined, Name: undefined, Status: undefined }), indicating no real data was returned. Test 2 outputs to 'unknown' port (not 'out'), so it does not qualify as a meaningful pass. Test 3 has exitCode 1 and is a schema generation test with a validation error — a clear failure. Test 4 outputs to 'unknown' port, not 'out'. Test 5 also outputs to 'unknown' port, not 'out'. Test 6 outputs to 'out' but contains an empty array ({ segments: [] }), which does not qualify as real data per the defined criteria. None of the tests satisfy all three conditions: testing actual component functionality, returning data to the 'out' port, and containing real non-empty data. The closest candidates (Tests 1 and 6) both fail on the data quality requirement — one has all undefined fields and the other has an empty segments array.
